question.:question/problem:
What is the exact value of $\tan\left(15^\circ\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $15^\circ = 150^\circ - 135^\circ$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $\frac{5\pi}{12} = \frac{2\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{4}$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(\frac{19\pi}{12}\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $\frac{19\pi}{12} = \frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{4\pi}{3}$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(\frac{11\pi}{12}\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $\frac{11\pi}{12} = \frac{2\pi}{3} + \frac{\pi}{4}$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(\frac{17\pi}{12}\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $\frac{17\pi}{12} = \frac{5\pi}{4} + \frac{\pi}{6}$.
